scope: Proves polynomial cumulative actual pickup energy implies analyticity of its actual Laplace integral throughout Re z>0, through explicit exponential unit-interval majorants and exact signed reconstruction. Combines the checked actual initial reciprocal transform, pole-removed analytic continuation, full zero reflection, and diagonal energy bound to prove literal PPNCP04.P04 implies root RiemannHypothesis. P04 is an explicit hypothesis; no unconditional P04 or RH theorem is asserted.
